message.title: PitLog v1.5.18 Released 🚀
message.body:
What's new in v1.5.18:

🔔 Update notifications — a bell icon in the top bar now alerts you when a new version is available

Autocomplete fixes — tag selection no longer adds a trailing comma, dropdown closes correctly on scroll

Dismiss suggestion (✕) now removes items from your history only — past trade values remain available

If you've already purchased PitLog, you don't need a new link — simply use the download link from your original purchase confirmation email and you'll automatically get the latest version.
